propositions: Store's local git call sites are unbounded under high concurrent use and lack a contention policy, causing transient failures to propagate to agents instead of being absorbed automatically

Concurrent rebar sessions contend on local git lock files (.git/index.lock, HEAD.lock, packed-refs.lock) without jittered backoff or advisory serialization, resulting in errors under normal high-concurrency operation

Per-store advisory lock plus bounded jittered retry/backoff at the store's git execution seam absorbs transient lock conflicts silently and surfaces only genuinely stuck locks with actionable error guidance
Uncontended store git operations must add zero latency by using non-blocking advisory lock acquisition on the fast path

All local-only git call sites must be bounded with watchdog-grade timeouts (120-300s) distinct from network latency budgets to prevent one hung mount from stalling all concurrent agents holding store write locks
